reason: Round 1 erroneously assumed Sigma |base64 implies case-sensitive matching because the Base64 alphabet is case-sensitive. Per official Sigma Modifiers Specification v2.1.0 and pySigma v1.5.1 (SigmaBase64Modifier.modify -> SigmaString), |base64 only Base64-encodes the literal into an uncased SigmaString, which follows Sigma's default case-insensitive matching; only explicit |cased produces SigmaCasedString.
